Package dev.turboism.sdk.plugin

Class PluginServiceUnavailableException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException
dev.turboism.sdk.plugin.PluginServiceUnavailableException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class PluginServiceUnavailableException extends UnsupportedOperationException
Thrown by PluginServiceDirectory.require(Class) when the requested optional service is not installed on the context.

The structured fields are the stable diagnostic contract. The exception message is intended for humans and must not be parsed.
